kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Classical Persian اُشْنَان (ušnān) or its Middle Persian ancestor, related to Arabic أُشْنَة (ʔušna, “moss, lichen”).
From Classical Persian اشنه (ušna) or its Middle Persian ancestor, as also Classical Syriac ܫܢܬܐ (šanṯā, “moss, lichen”); related to أُشْنَان (ʔušnān, “saltwort”).
g: moss, lichen (the name of various mosses and lichens)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أشن (form I)
# أَشُنُّ (ʔašunnu) /ʔa.ʃun.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of شَنَّ (šanna)
# أُشَنُّ (ʔušannu) /ʔu.ʃan.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of شَنَّ (šanna)
# أَشُنَّ (ʔašunna) /ʔa.ʃun.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَنَّ (šanna)
# أُشَنَّ (ʔušanna) /ʔu.ʃan.na/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunct
